title: Elastic materials break down pseudospectrally above a stiffness of about 390 GPa

statements.text: Continuum elasticity and nanoscale physics are two limits of one non-normal operator. When a dimensionless coupling exceeds one, transient energy growth becomes large while the spectrum stays stable, and for elements of at least a micrometer a longitudinal stiffness near 390 GPa marks the onset of catastrophic breakdown.

sources.quote: a longitudinal stiffness C11* ≈ 390 GPa marks the onset of catastrophic pseudospectral breakdown
